ptr.note: AVClass-bearing object (first member a non-NULL const AVClass *), written for the call: the option's field at its offset (or a child's, with AV_OPT_SEARCH_CHILDREN) is replaced, releasing the owned value it held. Wrapped as opt::ObjectMut (exclusive borrow). opt_set_init requires AV_OPT_TYPE_VIDEO_RATE; on a mismatching array option its error log reads opt_type_desc[o->type] out of bounds, so the wrapper refuses array options of another type (type_refusal). The value goes through set_number/write_number (num, den, intnum 1): range-checked as doubles (a zero den is ERANGE), then stored as the int pair it is, with no conversion.
Option name, compared with strcmp during the call only. Must not be NULL.
